I haven't updated the rotation runbook with this vendor limit yet.

transcript.text: I need to flag something critical. While investigating an unrelated mobile authentication ticket this morning, I confirmed that clients below Android SDK version 8.4 reject the new key identifier. About 17% of active mobile sessions are still on those older clients. The good news is we have a compatibility bridge that can be enabled before rotation, but it requires a seven-day overlap period with both old and new keys active. I have not yet filed the compatibility note documenting this. This means the current Saturday rotation plan as written would break authentication for roughly 17% of mobile users — we need to modify the runbook to include enabling the compatibility bridge and extending the overlap window before proceeding.
